text:
Sam: Okay serious question: who is responsible for naming the broken stool in the kitchen 'Sir Wobbles' and why is it now part of onboarding?
Alex: not me but it's a rite now. :laughing:
Priya: It was @Maya in 2023 after the Great Coffee Spill. We also have a tiny plaque. (pic link)
Maya: guilty. It defended me from a rogue laptop bag. I demand knighthood. :crown:
DevBot: maintenance-bot: Sir Wobbles reported as 'structurally charming'. Scheduled for minor resin patch tomorrow at 10am.
Vic: can we have a photo collage for the town hall? call it 'Wobblepedia'
Sam: also quick poll — keep Sir Wobbles as-is, replace with ergonomic throne, or rename to 'The Judge'?
Alex: A) keep and ceremonize
Priya: B) please replace, my back hurts thinking about it
Maya: A but only if we add a saddle and an origin story saga recital at new hire lunches
Ben: :thumbsup: for A (ceremony pls)
Riley: Forever Sir Wobbles. He fought bravely during the Great Coffee Spill.
Sam: alright looks like A is winning. i'll drop a tiny poll in #general tomorrow and maybe organise a ribbon-taping. anyone good with glitter glue? :sparkles:
